Pontoon it is. Here are the rules: both of my cards stay face down, and I win all ties. **Twist** to take a card. **Stick** to stand, but only on 15 or better. **Buy** doubles your stake for a face-down card, and you can do it more than once. A **pontoon** (ace plus a ten-value card) pays 2:1, and a **five-card trick** (five cards totalling 21 or less) beats every hand except a pontoon.

You start with 1,000 chips. Set your stake and deal when you're ready.
